jobs.occupation: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

• 
Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

• 
Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

• 
Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

• 
Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

• 
Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date. 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

• 
A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

• 
Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

• 
Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

• 
A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

• 
The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

• 
Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

• 
A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

• 
Bring good vibes to the work floor

• 
Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

• 
Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

• 
Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

• 
Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

• 
Have worked in an international workplace.

• 
Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.

A FEW MUST HAVES

• 
You speak fluent Danish and English.

• 
You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

• 
You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

• 
You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

• 
You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

• 
You love to work as we'll need you full time.

jobs.description:

Virksomhed: Hanse Byg ApS (CVR 45206548)

Arbejdssted: Skovmøllevej 35, 5474 Veflinge – samt byggepladser på Fyn og i det øvrige Danmark

Stillingstype: Fuldtid, fastansættelse

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

OM HANSE BYG APS

Hanse Byg ApS er en håndværksvirksomhed med base på Nordfyn. Vi udfører tømrer- og bygningssnedkerarbejde samt murer- og malerarbejde for både private og erhvervskunder. Vi er i vækst og søger derfor en dygtig og stabil construction worker, der kan indgå i vores faste team.

ARBEJDSOPGAVER

Du bliver en del af det daglige arbejde på vores byggepladser og kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

• 
Tømrer- og snedkerarbejde, herunder opsætning af konstruktioner, tage, gulve, vægge og lofter

• 
Murerarbejde, herunder opmuring, pudsning og flisearbejde

• 
Malerarbejde, herunder spartling, slibning og maling af overflader inde og ude

• 
Nedrivning, klargøring og opbygning af byggepladser

• 
Håndtering af materialer, værktøj og maskiner

• 
Almindeligt forefaldende arbejde på byggepladsen efter anvisning

VI FORVENTER, AT DU

• 
Har erfaring fra byggebranchen som construction worker, tømrer, murer, maler eller lignende

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret efter tegninger og anvisninger

• 
Har et godt håndelag og øje for kvalitet

• 
Er fysisk robust, mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

Kan arbejde sikkert og overholder gældende arbejdsmiljøregler

Varierede opgaver inden for tømrer-, murer- og malerfaget

Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort vej fra idé til handling

Mulighed for faglig udvikling

ANSØGNING

Send dit CV til job@vejentil.dk. Skriv "Construction Worker" i emnefeltet. Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og stillingen besættes, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Spørgsmål til stillingen kan sendes til samme e-mail.

----------------------------------------

Company: Hanse Byg ApS (CVR 45206548)

Location: Skovmøllevej 35, 5474 Veflinge, Denmark – and construction sites on Funen and across Denmark

ABOUT HANSE BYG APS

Hanse Byg ApS is a construction and craftsman company based in Northern Funen, Denmark. We carry out carpentry and joinery work as well as masonry and painting for private and commercial clients. We are growing and are looking for a skilled and reliable construction worker to join our permanent team.

YOUR TASKS

YOUR PROFILE

• 
Experience from the construction industry as a construction worker, carpenter, bricklayer, painter or similar

• 
Able to work independently and methodically from drawings and instructions

• 
Good craftsmanship and an eye for quality

• 
Physically fit, reliable and responsible

• 
Works safely and complies with applicable health and safety rules

• 
Speaks Danish or English at a working level

WE OFFER

A permanent full-time position in a growing company

• 
Salary according to qualifications and applicable collective agreement terms

An informal working environment with short decision paths

Opportunities for professional development

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to job@vejentil.dk with "Construction Worker" in the subject line. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

jobs.occupation: Passenger car auto mechanic
jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

• 
Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems).  

• 
Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

• 
Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors. No work on the high-voltage battery is required.

• 
Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

• 
Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a trained passenger car mechanic

• 
Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

• 
Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

• 
Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

• 
Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

• 
Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

• 
Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

• 
To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

• 
An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

• 
Ongoing training and good development opportunities

• 
A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

• 
Attractive terms of employment

• 
A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

jobs.occupation: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

• 
Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

• 
Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

• 
Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

• 
Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

• 
Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

• 
Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

• 
Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

• 
Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

• 
Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

• 
Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

• 
Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

• 
Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

• 
UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

• 
Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

• 
Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

• 
Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

• 
Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

• 
A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 
A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

• 
Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

• 
Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

• 
Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

• 
Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

• 
Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

• 
EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

• 
EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

• 
Danish language skills

Your competencies

• 
Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

• 
Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

• 
Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

• 
Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

• 
Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com) 

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator
jobs.description:
Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator — MK STUDIO, Glostrup

Hourly paid · 150 DKK/hour · Minimum 32 h/week guaranteed, Mon–Fri · Up to 40 h/week in busy periods · Start October–November 2026

MK STUDIO (mk-ceramics ApS) makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. We're a team of seven across the workshop, office and our Copenhagen shop, selling to cafés, roasters and coffee people across Denmark, the EU and Asia.

In a strong week we make 500–1000 cups. We're looking for the person who gets every order out the door correctly and makes sure nothing leaves the studio with a defect.

What you'll do

Orders and customers (about half your week)

• 
Pack 10–15 webshop orders a day, plus wholesale (B2B) orders

• 
Book shipments and print labels in the DHL and UPS apps

• 
Prepare invoices, packing lists and customs documents for shipments outside the EU

• 
Answer all order and customer emails: order status, delays, returns, breakage claims

• 
Handle claims with carriers for damaged or lost parcels

• 
Keep packing materials in stock

Studio and stock (about half your week)

• 
Unload kilns after the glaze firing

• 
Check every piece and sort it: first quality, seconds, reject

• 
Finishing work on fired pieces

• 
Organise the stock room and keep stock numbers correct in our order system

You're the last check before a piece reaches a customer.

What you need

• 
Fluent written and spoken English — you'll talk and write to customers every day

• 
Right to work in Denmark

• 
You can lift and carry up to 20 kg (kiln shelves, boxes) and work on your feet most of the day in a studio with clay dust

• 
Available Monday to Friday, at least 32 hours a week, with extra hours in busy periods, from October–November 2026

• 
Experience with order handling, shipping, warehouse, e-commerce, customer service or similar work

• 
You plan your own day, handle several tasks at once, and flag mistakes early

Good to have

• 
Danish

• 
Driving licence

• 
DHL/UPS bookings and claims

• 
Customs or export paperwork

• 
Experience packing fragile goods (glass, ceramics, wine)

• 
e-conomic, Shopify or spreadsheets

• 
Ceramics or quality-control experience

What we offer

• 
150 DKK/hour, plus holiday pay

• 
32 guaranteed hours a week

• 
3-month trial period

• 
After 6 months, we sit down and negotiate your pay based on your performance and any extra tasks you've taken on

• 
A small team with short lines and fast decisions

• 
Full training in our systems and quality standards

How to apply

Apply through the form at www.mk-ceramics.com/pages/mk-studio-work-with-us (select "Packing").

Write a short message telling us why you'd like to work with us and why you think you're a good fit for this job. Then answer these five questions with yes or no, based on this job ad:

Is this job paid by the hour?

• 
Is the guaranteed minimum 40 hours a week?

• 
Is about half of the job packing orders and answering customer emails?

• 
Do you need to work weekends in this job?

• 
Does the job start in January 2027?

We'll reply by email and ask for your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embryologist for a Private Fertility Clinic in Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to work as an embryologist at a private fertility clinic in Aarhus, where you will have supportive colleagues, sufficient time to perform your work and a high degree of influence?

We are looking for a skilled embryologist to join our clinic in Aarhus. You will become part of a multidisciplinary team united by a shared passion for making a difference to our patients.

About the position

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. Sellmer Klinik Aarhus is owned by Anette Sellmer, who forms the clinic’s management team together with Clinic Manager Bodil Meldgaard. Our management is visible and committed and delegates responsibility to employees who thrive on it.

We place our patients and a positive working environment at the heart of everything we do. This means, among other things, that you will have sufficient time to carry out your duties properly and will be expected to take an active part in developing and implementing new ideas.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

• 
IVF and ICSI

• 
Embryo transfer

• 
Thawing and cryopreservation of oocytes and blastocysts

• 
AHA

• 
Sperm preparation and cryopreservation

• 
Assessment of oocytes

• 
Administrative duties, including tasks related to the export of tissues and cells

Your colleagues

We have an excellent working environment and work very well together across professional disciplines. We respect and make use of each other’s expertise while keeping up with developments in the field and continuously improving our overall professional standards.

We also have a strong social community. We eat lunch together every day, enjoy spending time together and occasionally meet outside working hours. We value our positive working environment highly and make a genuine effort to protect it. It is therefore important to us that our new colleague feels at home and fits well within the team.

About you

• 
You are a qualified embryologist.

• 
You have experience within fertility treatment.

• 
You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues on patient-related tasks while also being comfortable working independently.

• 
You speak and write Danish and English.

• 
You are able to work 28–37 hours per week, including weekends and public holidays as part of a fixed rota.

We offer

A workplace with strong collegial support and professional sparring as part of a close multidisciplinary team. You can expect:

• 
Sufficient time to carry out your daily duties and a high degree of influence

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
Friendly and positive colleagues

• 
An organisation with a short path from decision to action

The terms of employment will depend on your experience and qualifications. Employment is conditional upon your consent to the clinic obtaining a satisfactory child protection certificate and upon holding the required professional authorisation.

For further information about the position, please contact Bodil Meldgaard at bodil@sellmerklinik.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
• Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
• Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
• Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
• Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
• Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
• Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
• Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
• Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
• Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

jobs.occupation: Lead Consultant – Vulnerability Management; DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Can you translate complex technical security requirements into something the business understands and acts on - and challenge where necessary?

Energinet is seeking a highly skilled cyber security professional to join our Attack Surface Management team within the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the link between the department's technical specialists and the rest of Energinet and ensure that security requirements are both understood, prioritised and complied with.

You combine solid technical insight with clear communication and business understanding. You present innovative ideas with confidence, along with the presence and authority to guide decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the operation and continual improvement of enterprise vulnerability management capabilities across IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Build, maintain, and optimize vulnerability scanning infrastructure, configurations, policies, and workflows.
• Develop scalable vulnerability assessment processes covering infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud workloads, containers, and identities.
• Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and vulnerability visibility across the enterprise.
• Manage lifecycle vulnerability processes from detection through validation, prioritization, remediation, and closure.
• Establish metrics and performance indicators to measure remediation effectiveness and risk reduction outcomes.
• Analyze attack paths, exposure chains, and security control weaknesses that could contribute to organizational risk.
• Develop risk-based methodologies for prioritizing exposures based on exploitability, business criticality, threat intelligence, and operational impact.
• Support continuous assessment of the organization's security posture through exposure analytics and attack surface monitoring.
• Serve as the technical owner and subject matter expert for vulnerability and exposure management platforms.

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority.” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding in cyber and information security and can go in-depth with technical solutions.
• Have CISSP or an equivalent certification (e.g. CISM) - or are close to earning it.
• Is an effective communicator who can communicate complex requirements clearly to both technicians, project managers and management.
• Works in a structured way and projects professional authority.
• Have business understanding and the ability to question constructively and create progress.
• Be fluent in English at a high level in writing and speech. Danish proficiency is an advantage but not mandatory. 
About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management - a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface. 

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organizational processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. 

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

jobs.occupation: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
jobs.description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

• 
Hvad du kan

• 
Hvordan du arbejder

• 
Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

• 
Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

• 
Om du tager ansvar

• 
Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

 HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

• 
Ansvar for bestemte kunder

• 
Kvalitetskontrol

• 
Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
Koordinering af kollegaer

• 
Planlægning af opgaver

• 
Kundekontakt

• 
Ansvar for bestemte områder

• 
Teamlederfunktioner

• 
Driftsansvar

• 
På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

 DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

 DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

 HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

• 
Være mødestabil og fleksibel

• 
Have en positiv attitude

• 
Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

• 
Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

• 
Have øje for detaljer

• 
Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

• 
Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

• 
Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

• 
Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

• 
Være løsningsorienteret

• 
Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

• 
Have kørekort kategori B

• 
Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

• 
Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

• 
Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk 

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

• 
Hvordan du møder på arbejde

• 
Hvordan du arbejder

• 
Hvordan du behandler kunder

• 
Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

• 
Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

• 
Om du tager ansvar

• 
Om du har lyst til at lære

• 
Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

 HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

 HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

 ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

 LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

• 
Hvem du er

• 
Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

• 
Din erfaring med private hjem

• 
Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

• 
Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

• 
Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk  Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

 JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

• 
What you can do

• 
How you work

• 
Your attitude and work ethic

• 
How you treat customers and colleagues

• 
Whether you take responsibility

• 
Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

 WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

• 
Responsibility for specific customers

• 
Quality control

• 
Training new employees

• 
Coordinating colleagues

• 
Planning tasks

• 
Customer communication

• 
Responsibility for specific areas

• 
Team leader responsibilities

• 
Operational responsibility

• 
Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

 YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

 YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

 WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

• 
Be reliable and flexible

• 
Have a positive attitude

• 
Be willing to learn and develop

• 
Work independently and as part of a team

• 
Have an eye for detail

• 
Take pride in delivering a perfect result

• 
Take responsibility for your work

• 
Receive and use feedback constructively

• 
Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

• 
Be solution-oriented

• 
Maintain an overview in a busy environment

• 
Have a valid Category B driving licence

• 
Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

• 
Be comfortable with possible weekend work

• 
Speak, understand, read, and write English 

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

• 
How you show up for work

• 
How you work

• 
How you treat customers

• 
How you work with colleagues

• 
How you respond to feedback

• 
Whether you take responsibility

• 
Whether you want to learn

• 
Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

 AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

 IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

 WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

 DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

• 
Who you are

• 
How long you have worked in cleaning

• 
Your experience with private homes

• 
Any commercial cleaning experience

• 
What you would like to develop within

• 
Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

• 
Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

• 
Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

• 
Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

• 
Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

• 
Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

• 
A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

• 
A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

• 
Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

• 
A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

• 
A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

• 
The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

• 
Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• 
Prior research and publication experience.

• 
Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

• 
Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

• 
Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

• 
Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

• 
Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

• 
A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

• 
The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

• 
Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

• 
Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

• 
Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  We are offering a PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level commencing 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

  Our group and research
 The hired PhD student will join the research group Data & Modelling which currently has 9 members, including one research assistant, two PhD students, and 6 associate professors. Our research group is focused advanced methods for monitoring and modelling data from animal production systems. This includes the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods. 

  Project description
 The PhD project will be focused on developing, assessing, and comparing traditional and modern ML and AI methods in terms of their utility and practicality for monitoring diverse types of time series data recorded at the levels of herds, groups of animals, and individual animals. The project will be based on already available data sets, and the collection of new data is not expected to be a part of this project.

  The data sets will include

   	
• Herd level input and production data with the aims of estimating e.g. infection status or environmental impact 	
• Sensor data record on or around individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns 	
• Video data recorded of individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns   The ML/AI methods will include

   	
• Traditional time series modelling, specifically dynamic linear models (a type of state space model) 	
• Neural network-based time series models, specifically transformers 	
• Convolutional neural networks, for encoding video frames 	
• Closed frontier large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini) 	
• Small open weights models to be run locally (e.g. Qwen3.5-9B, OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, Mistral Ministral 3 8B Reasoning)   The exact combinations of data sets and methods will depend on the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

  Principal supervisor is Associate professor Dan Børge Jensen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, daj@sund.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +4535333021.

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student + 3 months as research assistant for enrolment

  
 Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description:
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Anima Science).

  Qualifications:
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  The successful candidate should further be able to demonstrate the following:

   	
• Mastery of the R language for statistical computing 	
• Practical experience with the Keras and Tensorflow R packages 	
• Practical experience with state space models (e.g. dynamic linear models) for time series modelling 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating fully connected artificial neural networks 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating convolutional neural networks 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating transformer neural networks 	
• Practical experience with the use of large language models via API calls   Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence. 	
• Language skills   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and modern computer hardware for training artificial neural networks.

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

  The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline:  7 October 2026, 23.59pm CEST.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY
ACCOUNT MANAGER 

Vald.
BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially
focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE
POSITION

In order
to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales
team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will
be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are
market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector.
Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing
customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A
significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure
up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating
customer requirements and expectations.

The sales
process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components.
Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously
negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as
well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These
conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for
quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms. 

Your
normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in
Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production
Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company
stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your
external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around
50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and
presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as
continuously reporting to Sales Management. 

As part
of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the
customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact
between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out
visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’
cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine,
assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly
to the customer’s production line or application without further processing.
This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you
looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic
responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an
international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for
as a Key Account Manager. 

YOUR
DUTIES

You will
be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the
following:

• Responsibility
for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic
customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a
turnover of at least € 25 million
• Building
up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of
purchasing, development, quality and logistics
• Technical
and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
• Planning
and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major
framework agreements
• Ongoing
budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
• Searching
for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
• Close
internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and
finance
• Participation
in sales and strategy activities across the organisation
The
position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect
you to have the following:

• Extensive
advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial
skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade
background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another
option
• Experience
of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you
will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start
date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
• The
ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact,
and to plan your day-to-day work independently
• The
ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and
monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing
both text and numbers
• The
ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in
Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
• The
technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and
applications
• A
passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions
At a
personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious,
with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a
high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE
OFFER

You will
become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented
industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism.
In addition, you will receive:

• A
central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales
and commercial development
• A strong
professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
• Thorough
on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
• Good
opportunities for both professional and personal development
• Attractive
terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health
insurance
• A good
canteen scheme and active staff association
• An
informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and
sustainability
ABOUT THE
BIRN GROUP

Vald.
BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s
largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck
industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components.
Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of
our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are
in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you
have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to
contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group
HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please
note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close
the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the
start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your
application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link].
Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a
personality profile as part of the process.

We would
encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to
apply for the position.

jobs.description:
DAMRC is a research and development centre for advanced manufacturing. We are internationally recognised for our work in metal processing, and our job is to turn new technology into something Danish manufacturers can use on the shop floor.

You will work both in our own R&D centre in Herning, where trials can be run without stopping a production line, and out at the companies themselves, where the solution has to survive daily use.

We are now expanding the engineering team with two R&D Engineers.

Your role

As an R&D Engineer you will work on national and international research and development projects from the first idea through to implementation, at a high international technical level. Specifically, you will:

•     Drive the development and maturation of new machining technologies in our R&D centre

•     Play a central role in process and production optimisation for industrial customers

•     Work closely with cross-functional teams and industry partners

•     Contribute to technologies that support the green transition

•     Share what you find - with engineers, production managers and machine operators alike

Who we are looking for

We are filling two positions and they do not have to be identical profiles.

Essential

•     A degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or equivalent

•     Real understanding of machining - the process itself, not just the theory around it

•     The ability to explain a technical result clearly to very different audiences, from design engineers to machine operators

•     Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement

Advantageous

•     Specialisation in materials engineering

•     Hands-on experience with material processing and machining techniques

•     Strong analytical skills and experience with trial design, measurement or data analysis

•     Strong IT skills and familiarity with current engineering tools and methods

Ambitious recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you are early in your career we do not expect the experience - we expect curiosity and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

Eligibility. You must already be entitled to work in Denmark. We are not set up to handle work and residence permit applications, so we can only consider applicants who are citizens of the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or who already hold a valid Danish work permit.

What we offer

•     A high-technology research centre in strong growth, where you are invited to contribute both professionally and personally

•     Direct contact with our members and customers, and time spent inside companies most engineers never see from the inside

•     An innovative, supportive environment alongside highly skilled colleagues who share your interest in engineering

•     Work with technologies that drive the green agenda forward

Living in Herning

Interested in joining an international community in Denmark? Herning has a diverse expat network, and we will welcome you into it.

About DAMRC

DAMRC – Danish Advanced Manufacturing Research Center – is a leader in metal processing and is internationally recognised for ground-breaking innovation.

Our mission is to help Danish companies succeed through innovation and the use of the latest technology. We work in close collaboration with our members, which include several leading companies in metal processing and the machinery industry.

Since 2010 we have completed more than 400 industry projects.

We are a team of around 30 based at Industrivej Syd 17A, 7400 Herning, Denmark.
